en: Sepia-toned interior view of a historical study room with a window on the left, light curtains, a wooden floor, and a classic wooden writing desk with drawers and cubbyholes. Two cane-backed chairs stand in front of and beside the desk. A small bookshelf is partly visible to the left of the desk. On the wall above the desk hang two large silhouette portraits facing each other and two smaller framed pictures between and below them. A closed wooden door is on the right. The bottom margin of the image contains a handwritten-style caption in German indicating this is Goethe's study on the second floor.
